other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Cogeneration listed among potential energy-efficiency interventions for industrial/thermal systems, but only as a generic mention with no continuous-process application
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
heat recovery for boiler feed water; cogeneration; 
optimization of combustion process in the boiler

one_line: The paper develops and applies an energy-audit / energy-performance-indicator methodology (and a simulation tool for high-efficiency electric-motor replacement) empirically demonstrated on tertiary-sector buildings—supermarkets and office buildings—and general Italian SMEs, not on any continuous-flow production process.
